purpose: Qualify information-identifiable delayed causal effects and strong conventional/symbolic headroom before a new direct weight-writing learner is specified.

source_usage.fixture_ids: 0..7 only until separately admitted original PUBLIC
source_usage.original_public: 99011..99042; do not instantiate for control development
source_usage.original_reserved: 99101..99164; never instantiate without independent first-use authority
source_usage.training: 24 passive episodes of 4 steps + 8 active/8 random four-step episodes per world, 128 total transitions per method, identical passive histories
source_usage.test: 24 original heldout initial visible states, two counterfactual three-step sequences per state, no labels in training, no fitting using original heldout outcomes
source_usage.fairness: All controls and candidate receive same observation/action histories for their assigned arm; independent symbolic and recurrent strong controls receive ACTIVE arm observations.
source_usage.negative: Repeated snapshot, invalid action, history erase and shuffled-action binding must be reported distinctly.

symbolic.name: Independent finite-state version-space causal inducer
symbolic.grammar: Per visible node enumerate ordered-equivalent 15 distinct visible-parent pairs, 4 sign flips, 6 Boolean gates (360 clauses). For hidden latch j enumerate 4 distinct trigger actions x 15 distinct visible-parent XOR predicates x 2 parity flips (120 candidates per latch), keeping only combinations consistent with full observed four-step reset episodes.
symbolic.hidden_protocol: Each episode starts hidden bits 00. Hidden h_j toggles after action iff action=trigger_j and XOR(x_p,x_q,flip)=1, using ONLY observed visible x, never oracle hidden.
symbolic.consistency: For outputs j=0..3, predicted next state is clause(x) XOR PREVIOUS h_(j mod 2); last two outputs are clause(x). Keep only latch candidates with at least one consistent clause for each linked output, and require distinct trigger actions for the two latched bits.
symbolic.prediction: From a new heldout reset, propagate each surviving candidate's two hidden bits using actions and the model's own predicted visible state. Score per output by posterior majority over consistent joint program hypotheses; exact tie predicts zero. Do not access hidden state, oracle program, target y or evaluator identifiability during prediction.
symbolic.abstention: When no consistent program, classify INVALID_MODEL_FIT; no nearest-truth fallback.
symbolic.budget: Max 120 latch candidates per latch, max 360 clauses per visible output, at most 120*120 pairings (valid distinct trigger only); fixed complete enumeration; report time and candidate counts.
symbolic.expected: Potentially perfect grammar-constrained strong control; if it reaches ceiling it is evidence task too easy for demonstrating direct-write superiority.

recurrent.name: Conventional fully gradient-trained tanh RNN with BPTT and Adam
recurrent.input: Current six observed visible bits scaled to {-1,+1} concatenated with one-hot action of size 4 (10 inputs), teacher-forced source episodes only.
recurrent.model: Hidden 16 tanh units reset to zero every episode; h_t=tanh(W_x input_t + W_h h_prev + b_h), six output logits = W_out h_t+b_out; logistic next-bit prediction.
recurrent.initialization: NumPy Generator(PCG64(seed)), Gaussian N(0,0.10) for matrices, zero biases, float64; train each independent seed from scratch.
recurrent.optimizer: Full-batch exact backpropagation through all four steps, binary cross entropy all six bits, Adam beta1=0.9 beta2=0.999 epsilon=1e-8; initial LR=0.01, weight decay=0.0001, global norm gradient clip 5.0.
recurrent.early_stopping: None; no heldout feedback; all epochs mandatory unless divergence => INVALID.
recurrent.source_fit: Report train source output-bit exact threshold accuracy for each seed. If strongest seed fails >=95% train bit accuracy or if NaNs occur, overall science result is INVALID, not proof of direct write superiority.
recurrent.ensemble: Report each seed independently; strongest source-fit seed is selected solely by source training loss then source fit, before test labels, with tie-breaking by smallest seed. No heldout-driven selection.
recurrent.cost: Whole-process CPU + wall time and learned parameter count. No claim of matched FLOPs/cost with symbolic or direct-write model; report these separately.

memoryless.name: History-erased tanh network negative comparator
memoryless.input: Current six visible bits and one-hot action only; no recurrent hidden state or earlier actions.
memoryless.optimizer: Same loss, Adam parameters, initialization family and batch as recurrent; fresh models and frozen seeds, source-only selection.
memoryless.purpose: Tests whether agent history yields useful information beyond current observation.

classification.TASK_SCIENTIFIC_SUPPORTED: After independent original PUBLIC only: >=25% valid same-immediate/different-later causal pairs; recurrent improves final bit accuracy >=8 percentage points versus memoryless control; strongest symbolic and recurrent each source-fit >=95%; strongest heldout accuracy among strong controls is 65..95% inclusive; no data leakage/custody violation. This qualifies challenge headroom, NOT weight programming advantage.
classification.TASK_CEILING: Strongest qualified control >95% heldout accuracy: the task leaves insufficient headroom to distinguish mechanisms; preserve result, do not tune after viewing it.
classification.TASK_NEGATIVE: History-aware best <= memoryless+8pp, or <25% valid delayed causal pairs despite valid source; preserve negative.
classification.INVALID: Strong control source-fit <95%, inconsistent symbolic version space, any original first-use before admission, hidden/oracle leakage, cross-OS mismatch, budget violation, or source identity issue.
classification.DIRECT_WEIGHT_SUPERIORITY: Not testable in this gate; requires separate candidate/prereg/independent first-use and exceeding strongest source-matched control with compute/action parity.

technical_scope: Only frozen control protocol and fixture-only comparators; no original world generation, no modification of accepted Yggdrasil substrate, no merging, deployment, schedule, runner/controller invocation, or paid APIs.
code_dependency: Python 3.12, numpy==2.1.3 installed only by fixture-only CI workflow if needed; no GPU or network model service.
